title: Sweet Yellow Macaron Cake
description: A French-inspired sweet macaron cake, featuring a delicate yellow flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and prepare a baking sheet.
In a large bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Gradually add the granulated sugar (for meringue) and whip until stiff and glossy.
In another bowl, whisk together the milk, yellowed sweet butter, and granulated sugar.
Fold the meringue mixture into the milk mixture until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the French macaron shells.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the tops are golden brown.
Allow the cake to cool completely on a wire rack.
Once cooled, dust with powdered sugar and serve.
